suites.label: Triage
suites.description: Patient messages under a supplied triage policy: urgency, red flags and route. A missed emergency or red flag zeroes the whole message.

suites.label: Notes
suites.description: Real-length clinical notes: assertion status of a condition and status of a medicine. A dangerous misread (an allergy read as a medicine taken) zeroes the note.

suites.label: Criteria
suites.description: Criteria checks where insufficient information is correct: real CMS-HCC V28 support, trial eligibility and prior authorisation.

suites.label: Coding
suites.description: The most specific ICD-10-CM FY2026 code for a condition in a short note, from a shortlist of real codes with official titles, or none of these.
